quarterly_data.quarter: Fujifilm press release: Fujifilm Completes New Production Facility for Advanced (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fujifilm completed a new production building for post-CMP cleaners at the Oita Factory of FUJIFILM Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. (FFEM); the facility began operations in August and triples production capacity at the Oita Factory, for post-CMP cleaners used in manufacturing advanced semiconductors including those for AI applications. The company says demand for its post-CMP cleaners is expected to more than double in terms of sales by FY2030 compared with FY2024 (company fiscal-year naming), driven by miniaturization and 3D stacking for AI semiconductors, and is expanding sales particularly among customers in North America, Europe and key manufacturing hubs in Asia. The company states its semiconductor materials business achieved an average annual sales growth rate of approximately 20% from FY2021 through FY2025, and that it invested more than 100 billion yen from FY2021 to FY2024 (CMP slurry capacity in Japan, the United States and Taiwan; polyimide capacity in Japan and Belgium), with demand for its photosensitive dielectric materials for advanced packaging, including ZEMATES, growing rapidly.
quarterly_data.figure: Oita post-CMP cleaner production capacity tripled (operations began in August); post-CMP cleaner demand expected to more than double in sales terms by FY2030 vs FY2024; semiconductor materials average annual sales growth approximately 20% FY2021-FY2025
